assertions.assertion: Response explains the cookie extends because IdentityServer re-issues it via SignInAsync when the session's client list changes
assertions.rationale: Explains SignInAsync is called when session client list changes, re-issuing cookie.

assertions.assertion: The web.app client sets UserSsoLifetime to an 8-hour value (28800 seconds) to force interactive re-authentication
The client sets RefreshTokenExpiration = TokenExpiration.Absolute together with AbsoluteRefreshTokenLifetime to cap refresh-driven session extension
